race.comment: CANTARITO (7) just missed first up at the Sunny Coast before getting the job done in style at Ipswich last time. Has further improvement to come and the rise in trip suits. Can make it two on the bounce. ROSSO LEVANTO (6) has returned in good order this prep, notching two wins from three starts. Gets in light with the 3kg claimer engaged and only needs to hold her form to be right there again. WOUNDER (13) is rock-hard fit and carries strong peaks. Gets a key switch to Thompson and is drawn favourably. Can give this a big shake. MARENARO (1) drops back in trip off a 32-day freshen and gets an important 2kg claim from hot-hand apprentice Williams. Don't underestimate.
